units: Targ. Ps. LXXXVI, 11.—Part. pass. מְיַחַד united, harmonious.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 19:2">Targ. Y. Ex. XIX, 2</cite> (cmp. <cite ref="E00240"><he>הוֹמוֹנְיָא</he></cite>).

Macc. 18ᵃ ליַחוּדֵי לאוי וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. לי׳ להו) to forbid each of these acts singly (as if each were prohibited by a special prohibitory law, v. לַאו).—Part. pass. מְיָחַד = h. מְיוּחָד (v. preced.).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 26:10">Targ. O. Gen. XXVI, 10</cite> <he>דמְיָ׳ בעמא</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>מְיָחֵיד</he>; Y. <he>מלכא דמֵיחַד</he>) a distinguished person of the people.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 15:20">Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 15:22">22</cite> <he>מְיַיחֵד</he> designated; a. e.
